name: Zechariah (John's father)
title: Priest and father of John the Baptist
summary: Zechariah was a priest of the division of Abijah, married to Elizabeth. The angel Gabriel announced to him in the temple that he would have a son, John. Because he doubted, he was made mute until the child was born, and then praised God in a prophetic song.

keyEvents.title: Gabriel announces the birth of John
keyEvents.description: While Zechariah was serving as priest, the angel Gabriel appeared to him and promised him a son, John; he was made mute until the child was born.
